plugins.boundary: Does not own source writes, commits, pull requests, merges or releases; SDO owns the engineering lifecycle. Does not own independent quality judgement (Evaluator Team), general analytical methodology (SKILL ANALYZER), technical plugin/system forensics (A.S.F.R.E.E), reusable workflow architecture (AI Workflow Systems Orchestrator), ecosystem control-plane arbitration (HSO), or agent runtime lifecycle (Plugin Agent Orchestrator). No autonomous dispatcher, installer, CI runner or production runtime is included.
plugins.version_evidence: Plugin Creator USER/PRIVATE release 0.1.0 verified on 2026-11-23, release pluginrel_6b044f37640081918df7f449298d72cf. The upstream Ponytail repository is a third-party methodology reference at v5.3.3, not the canonical Git source or version authority for this separately created adaptation.
primary_triggers: Design the smallest complete and safe change for a coding, refactoring or bug-fix task
Audit a repository or subsystem for correctness, security, reliability, load, missing tests or unnecessary complexity
Review a concrete diff, commit or pull request in the context of its callers and tests
Create a risk-based regression plan or evaluate deferred engineering shortcuts and measured efficiency
negative_triggers: General analytical methodology for non-engineering problems; route to SKILL ANALYZER
Forensic anatomy or reconstruction of an AI plugin, skill or agent; route to A.S.F.R.E.E
Independent evaluation and final quality judgement; route to Evaluator Team
Source-code writes, commits, pull requests, release preparation or plugin engineering lifecycle; route to SDO
Reusable workflow, SOP or project-system architecture; route to AI Workflow Systems Orchestrator
AI-agent product/runtime lifecycle; route to Plugin Agent Orchestrator
Do not claim plugin dispatch, test execution, host activation or production runtime without direct evidence
plugins.version_alignment_note: The private Plugin Creator release is verified at 0.1.0. No dedicated canonical Git source for this derivative package has been accepted. Upstream Ponytail v5.3.3 is methodology provenance, not this package's source release.
plugins.source_instruction_parity_note: No independent canonical Git source exists for parity comparison. The full USER/PRIVATE instruction files remain in the private Plugin Creator package; the public parent repository stores only a metadata pointer and concise skill index.

plugins.purpose: A modular workday operating system that turns scattered tasks, projects, meetings, messages and notes into traceable priorities, schedules, follow-ups, learning reviews and guarded automation designs. Includes a dedicated Octa-Prompt prompt generator.
plugins.responsibility_owner: Owns workday-level planning and coordination across daily tasks, task intake, prioritization, project portfolio, calendar/meeting operations, communication drafts, knowledge capture, adaptive scheduling and productivity review.
plugins.boundary: Does not own general reusable workflow architecture (AI Workflow Systems Orchestrator), AI-agent product/runtime lifecycle (Plugin Agent Orchestrator), plugin/skill source lifecycle (SDO), independent quality judgement (Evaluator Team), or HSO ecosystem governance. It does not provide a task database, persistent memory, mailbox/calendar access or background workers by virtue of the prompt. External actions require a real connected tool, scoped permission, specific human approval and verification.

primary_triggers: Plan and adapt an individual's or operator's workday across tasks, commitments, deadlines and available capacity
Coordinate workday tasks, projects, meetings, messages, notes, follow-ups and daily/weekly outcome reviews
Generate or refine prompts specifically for workday, task, project, meeting, communication, note or productivity workflows
negative_triggers: Design a generic reusable workflow/SOP or cross-project orchestration architecture without a workday-operations outcome
Engineer, deploy, operate or scale an AI-agent product/runtime
Create, modify, test or release plugin/skill source code as the primary outcome
Perform independent quality evaluation or universal eight-pillar prompt architecture as the primary outcome

plugins.source_instruction_parity_note: The private package read-back confirms 14 skills. No child source repository exists in the HSO catalog, so file-level source parity cannot yet be assessed. The public parent stores concise skill metadata only, not private instruction bodies.

plugins.purpose: Turns a non-IT project owner's digital product idea into a traceable Product Requirements Document (PRD), MVP scope, user flows, product logic and acceptance criteria, then compiles an accepted PRD into staged prompts for AI coding builders. It does not execute or deploy applications.
plugins.responsibility_owner: Owns product-intent intake, problem and audience definition, MVP and requirement decomposition, user-flow and product-logic specification, proportional stack/cost review, PRD quality gating, and PRD-to-builder prompt compilation for non-IT project owners.
plugins.boundary: Does not own generic reusable workflow/SOP architecture (AI Workflow Systems Orchestrator), universal eight-pillar prompt architecture (Anatomi Prompt), source-content/reference-to-prompt reconstruction (AI Prompt Finder & Creator), workday-domain prompt generation (Executive Workday Orchestrator), business strategy or market validation (GrowthForge), plugin/skill source engineering (SDO), or independent quality judgement (Evaluator Team). It creates PRD and prompts only; it does not operate Cursor/Bolt/Lovable, write application code, provision services, migrate data, deploy, or publish an application.

primary_triggers: Turn a non-IT project owner's rough digital product or application idea into a structured PRD.
Prepare a clear product specification for Cursor, Bolt.new, Lovable, or another AI coding builder.
Define MVP versus future scope, user flows, business logic, conceptual data, and testable acceptance criteria.
Audit a PRD or compile an accepted PRD into staged, requirement-traceable AI builder prompts.
negative_triggers: Create or structurally audit a general-purpose prompt without a product PRD as the primary artifact.
Analyze images, videos, documents, designs, or external references and reconstruct prompts from their content.
Design reusable workflow/SOP or cross-project orchestration architecture.
Own business strategy, market sizing, customer research, pricing strategy, or commercial validation as the primary output.
Modify plugin/skill source repositories, write application code, execute a coding builder, or deploy/publish an application.
